title: Your dog isn't being dirty when he humps 🐕
caption:
It's usually not what you think 😅🐕
Tag a dog owner who needs this 👇
sources: American Kennel Club, 'Why Do Dogs Hump?' (play, excitement, stress, attention-seeking; neutered dogs and females also mount)
ASPCA / VCA Animal Hospitals: redirect calmly; sudden or excessive mounting can indicate urinary tract, skin or other medical problems
